integration_removed.description:
The Mazda integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The library that __HA_KEEP__ uses to connect with their services, [has been taken offline by Mazda]({dmca}).

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your __HA_KEEP__ setup. [View your existing Mazda integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The Mazda integration has been removed
